action.details: Invokes Tembo's published “Search in Tembo” macOS Service. Multi-line selections and selections longer than 300 characters are rejected before the Service is called.
action.exampleOutput: Tembo searches the Mac for the selected phrase.
action.name: Tembo Search
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text locally to Tembo through its macOS Service. The selection does not leave your Mac.
action.requirements: Tembo 1, 2, or 3 must be installed with its Search Service enabled. Select one line of 300 characters or fewer.
action.summary: Search for the selected text in Tembo.
